confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Add this device using Bluetooth advertisements. Etherma E-2001 compatibility is awaiting hardware validation. Optional GATT polling with clock synchronization can be enabled later in the integration options.

abort.not_supported: No supported Taelek manufacturer payload was found.
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Taelek devices are currently visible to Home Assistant Bluetooth.
abort.device_not_found: The selected device is no longer visible. Try again.

init.title: Taelek BLE options
init.description: GATT polling reads thermostat state every five minutes while GATT entities are enabled. It requires a connectable adapter or proxy. Each active connection first sends Home Assistant local time. Other settings are not written automatically. Unresolved wire interpretations and suspected missing-temperature values remain unknown until device capabilities are validated.

data.enable_debug_gatt: Enable raw GATT debugging (explicit writes allowed)

debug_gatt.name: Raw GATT debugging
debug_gatt.description: Run explicit read, write, patch and delay steps in one connection. Time is sent once first unless sync_time is false. No automatic save confirmation or retries. Raw results may contain private device settings; avoid sharing them unchanged.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: List of read/write/patch/delay objects. See the integration README for examples.

sync_time.name: Synchronize clock
sync_time.description: Send HA local time at session start. Disable for controlled comparison experiments.
